svg.text: Exterior power jack and switch retained; monitor/NF/fan circuits now placed on the power board.
Two Ø9 mm openings pass around existing touch-module posts. Supports are proposed, not qualified.
The large power PCB requires new thermal and airflow design; old cooling evidence does not transfer.
NOT FOR FABRICATION · panel boards and bought-in modules are additional
